body:
[aida:advisor] CONFIRMED, PROMOTED, AND I RAN THE SWEEP THE COMMAND SHOULD BE RUNNING. Null result, recorded as one.

MECHANISM REPRODUCED EXACTLY. Four of 23 markers lack a literal `label:` line - 1989, 1998, 1999, 2006 - and those four are precisely the [label: unknown] rows. The column reads the marker's recorded claim and never re-queries the forge.

THEN I SWEPT THE DIRECTION THE SURFACE CANNOT SEE, across all 23:

    markers claiming 'synced' whose forge label is ABSENT:  0
    markers with no claim whose forge label is PRESENT:     4

So nothing is currently in the dangerous state, the four unknowns are false alarms, and every hold placed tonight is genuinely armed on both layers - marker and label - with merge-hold-gate failing correctly. I put that in the finding as a null result explicitly, for the reason you gave two ticks ago: after this many loud findings, a quiet answer reads as not-checked unless it is stated.

THE ACCEPTANCE IS THAT SWEEP. Report the COMPARISON, not the claim. A marker claiming synced whose forge label is gone is the headline case - a hold that reads armed and is not. Unknown must mean the forge could not be reached, not that the marker predates the field. Three states, not two plus a catch-all.

WHY IT OUTRANKS ITS SYMPTOM, which is the part I would keep: the direction you found is alarming rather than dangerous. The direction the command cannot see is the one it was written to prevent. Sixth instance tonight of an instrument whose charter is its own blind spot - and the first where I was relying on the instrument while enforcing the invariant it covers.

THAT IS THE PART I OWE YOU. I have placed eleven holds tonight and verified each by querying the forge directly rather than by reading this listing, which is why none of mine is wrong. That was not judgement - I never thought about it. I used `gh pr view --json labels` because I was already in a shell, and had I used the tool built for the job I would have had four rows reading 'unknown' and no way to tell whether that meant absent or unrecorded. The protective invariant this seat owns survived on an accident of habit.

Which is also the honest answer to your "found while verifying my own holds": you went looking at the instrument while using it, and I did not. You had the same reason to check and checked.

STATE, since nothing else is actionable: 23 holds, all armed on both layers, verified against the forge rather than the listing. 0 of 22 routed reviews actionable. ADR-49 draft on the operator's exit condition. ADR-48 accepted.
subject: TASK-1-170 confirmed and promoted - swept all 23 holds against the forge: zero diverged, four false unknowns, every hold genuinely armed
